  <g>

  <text x="34" y="507" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">Bayar, kirim, dan simpan uang dengan cepat,</text>
  <text x="34" y="528" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">aman, dan mudah dalam satu aplikasi.</text>

    <text x="195" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0F1225">Lanjutkan</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="800" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g transform="translate(28,806)">

      <text x="14" y="33" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#3F63F6">Beranda</text>

    <g transform="translate(192,806)">

      <path d="M10 25 Q14 18 18 25" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="14" y="33" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Akun</text>
    </g>
  </g>
